bioconda.name: pmotools
bioconda.summary: Tools for creating and manipulating Portable Microhaplotype Object (PMO) files.
bioconda.description: pmotools provides utilities for creating, validating, manipulating, and converting Portable Microhaplotype Object (PMO) files. PMO is a JSON-based standard for storing phased targeted sequencing (microhaplotype) data and associated metadata, enabling interoperable analysis, data sharing, and reproducible workflows across targeted sequencing applications.
